title: In-Context Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Gradient-Descent Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2605.26356v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In-context learning has recently been linked to implicit gradient descent in linear self-attention models, suggesting that context can induce a forward-pass update. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) also relies on context, but retrieved documents are usually treated as static evidence rather than signals for adaptation. We study RAG as an in-context optimization process. First, we show that one linear self-attention layer can implement one gradient-descent step on a unified linearized RAG objective covering both projection-based and dot-product retrieval interfaces. This gives an exact regime where retrieval-augmented prediction and in-context optimization coincide. We use this result not as a literal model of LLM computation, but as a guide for adapting the interaction between queries and retrieved evidence. translated_title: 检索增强生成的上下文内优化：梯度下降视角
translated_abstract: 上下文学习近期被与线性自注意力模型中的隐式梯度下降联系起来，表明上下文可以在前向传播过程中引发更新。检索增强生成（RAG）同样依赖上下文，但检索到的文档通常被视为静态证据，而非用于适配的信号。我们将RAG作为一个上下文内优化过程进行研究。首先，我们证明单层线性自注意力可以在一个统一的线性化RAG目标上实现一步梯度下降，该目标同时涵盖基于投影和点积两种检索接口。这给出了检索增强预测与上下文内优化完全重合的精确情形。我们并非将这一结果作为LLM计算的字面模型，而是将其用作调整查询与检索证据之间交互方式的指导。随后，我们检验了这种对应关系的边界：它在受控的线性扩展下保持稳定，但会随特征……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将检索增强生成（RAG）形式化为上下文内优化过程，证明单层线性自注意力可在统一的线性化RAG目标上执行一步梯度下降，并以此理论洞察指导查询与检索证据之间交互方式的设计。
en_tdlr: The paper formalizes RAG as an in-context optimization process, proving that a single linear self-attention layer can implement one gradient-descent step on a unified linearized RAG objective, and uses this theoretical insight to guide the design of query-evidence interactions.
